prompt: At a desert oasis, a clear pool of water reflects a cluster of seven date palms arranged in a loose circle. Five clay pots filled with water sit on a low wooden table beside a donkey tethered to a post. A woven rug is spread on the sand under a low tent supported by carved wooden poles. A pile of fresh dates rests on a palm-leaf tray, and a brass lantern hangs from a tent rope. Two camels graze on sparse shrubs nearby while a falcon perches on a leather glove placed on a stone block. A set of ceramic bowls sits beside a water skin on the rug. There is no plastic chair, no metal grill, no paper book, no glass window, and no modern clock.
